sketch_notes: Both sketches depict a largely static marketing/content layout: headline text, a button-like call-to-action, hero imagery, body copy, and a grid/list of feature cards. There are no explicit indicators of menus, tabs, accordions, search, forms, overlays, counters, or progressive loading. The only potentially interactive-looking element is the single bordered call-to-action/button, but a basic link/button click is not one of the requested JavaScript interaction patterns and does not by itself imply custom JS behavior. Cross-viewport differences appear to be responsive layout changes only, which can be handled with CSS rather than JavaScript.
